data.name: Welcome Center
data.description: The Welcome Center is a great first stop when entering the park. Rangers and volunteers are on duty daily to provide visitors with the latest information on the current conditions, hiking information, things to do and the daily schedule of ranger-led activities. The Hawai'i Pacific Parks Association operates a park store in the Welcome Center that sells books, posters, and other educational materials. Proceeds benefit park programs.
data.audioDescription: The Welcome Center is located within the Kilauea Military Camp. To the left of the entrance is the Hawai'i Pacific Parks Association park store, and to the right are two large exhibits. One exhibit is an image of Native Hawaiians on a voyaging canoe headed toward an erupting volcano. The second exhibit is a promotional graphic for Friends of Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park. At the far end of the Welcome Center is a ranger desk and orientation panels.

data.directionsInfo: The Welcome Center is a 1.25 mile drive beyond the park entrance station on the right. The building is located near the U.S. flag pole. Parking is available at the nearby ballfield.

operatingHours.description: Welcome Center is open daily from 9 a.m. to 4:45 p.m.

data.name: Kahuku Visitor Contact Station
data.description: Located at the Kahuku Unit of the park in the district of Ka'ū, the Kahuku Visitor Contact Station provides park information, assistance, and books and gifts available through Hawaiʻi Pacific Parks Association.
data.audioDescription: A large green and white wooden building with a corrugated tin roof. The interior walls are lined with photographs, information, and maps related to Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park and the island of Hawaiʻi. Books, gifts, and souvenirs are available for sale.

passportStampImages.altText: A green passport stamp for the Kahuku Unit of Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park
passportStampImages.title: Passport Stamp For Kahuku Unit

data.directionsInfo: Kahuku Visitor Contact Station. Turn into Kahuku near the 70.5 mile marker on Hwy 11 in Kaʻū. Approximately 1 hour drive from Welcome Center.

operatingHours.description: Kahuku Unit is open Thursday to Sunday from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.
operatingHours.name: Kahuku Visitor Contact Station
